gaps.sentence: Please be ___ — the baby is sleeping.
gaps.explanation: 'Quiet' means making little or no noise; 'quite' is an adverb meaning fairly or completely.

gaps.sentence: The new law will ___ every driver in the country.
gaps.explanation: 'Affect' is the verb meaning to have an influence on; 'effect' is normally a noun meaning a result.

gaps.sentence: The two designs are quite ___ from each other.
gaps.explanation: 'Different from' — the adjective is required after 'quite'.

gaps.hint: noun meaning a moral rule; fixed phrase 'on principle'
gaps.explanation: 'On principle' means because of a moral belief; 'principal' means main or the head of a school.

gaps.sentence: The city archive preserves ___ maps of the harbour from the 1700s.
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' describes things connected with the study of the past; 'historic' means momentous.

gaps.sentence: This tooth is ___ and will probably fall out soon.
gaps.explanation: 'Loose' is an adjective meaning not firmly fixed; 'lose' is the verb meaning to no longer have.

gaps.sentence: The medicine had an immediate ___ on her pain.
gaps.hint: a noun is needed after 'an immediate'
gaps.explanation: 'Effect' is the noun meaning result; the fixed phrase is 'have an effect on something'.

gaps.sentence: Tax is calculated on your total annual ___.
gaps.hint: all the money you receive from every source
gaps.explanation: 'Income' is all the money you receive from work, investments, rent and so on during a period.
